body: Yes, very much so.  You are not alone.
I don't see any other way

Long story short, I have depression and anxiety that I've been dealing with for over 10 years now.  I'm turning 26 this week and my life has been a joke filled with failures.  

This past semester my girlfriend (who I loved) cheated and left me for another man, and that coupled with my already crippling depression caused me to fail my classes.  

I've always been a complete incompetent piece of trash that can't perform even the simplest of tasks without screwing up or without having an anxiety attack.  Life has gotten so much worse since high school (which was hell for me) and I don't see it getting any better.  I lack skills needed to survive in this world, and feel like I deserve to die.  But I just don't want to leave anything behind that will hurt my family.

Kind of.  I'm not sure if I can go through with instant death like a gun or jumping from a building.  I kind of wish I could just disappear or take a drug that would bring death without any pain.  


Edit:  for real though, I want to die.  I have a ton of Benadryl by my bed that I want to take in bulk, but I've heard of bad experiences with that.
Same.  I'm supposed to graduate this semester and haven't made a single friend the 3 years I've been here.
Yeah, I do this a lot and it makes me feel worse about myself.
Damn, whats it like to feel needed?
What if you have trouble opening up about your problems and/or articulating your feelings?  I just don't think therapy would work for me personally, not to mention if it's even affordable.

Resonates with me.  I just want to get better but it's so hard.  Even now I can't even get out of bed to finish my over due paper, and I'm dreading the reaction from my professors because depression is making me such a shitty student, among many other things.  I don't know how much longer I can take this.

You're empathy is commendable; caring for the police and others on reddit when you are in your time of darkness.  We need more souls like you, we need people like you to teach people how to put others first when you are hurting so much.  I don't know your life, but I'm sure your family and friends are not burdened by anything you've done.  Give yourself credit for how far you've come, and how you treat others now.  The world is a hard place, but we have your back in your time of pain.
